customer: hi so were going down to one car and i want to sell my midsize suv to you, but i paid off the loan last yr and the title still says the bank is the lienholdr?? im in Corlan if that matters. what do i do
agent: That means the lien hasn't been released yet, so the first step is to ask your lender for a lien release letter. If you can't get one, you can sign our lien release request, form NW-LRL-1, and we'll contact the lender for you, though this can add 1 to 2 weeks. We can still make an offer on your SUV and book your appointment while you wait. And if Corlan uses electronic titles, the lender sends the release to the state electronically.
